title: The screenplay: 28 story points the film validates toward
text: The owner watched animatic 04 and saw arms waving and nothing happening. Every probe was green because no probe asks whether anything changes on screen. v3/screenplay.json is the director's draft: 28 story points with stable ids (sp-1.1 to sp-8.3), each naming the action, what the character wants, the turn, which beat-sheet state flips after it, what the audience sees, the colour key and emitter, the register, and a measure line a probe can check (a prop that appears, a position that moves, a garment that changes). Keys, blocking, light and probes bind to the ids; a story probe refuses a story point whose before and after differ only in the figure layer. v3/screenplay.md is rendered from it for reading. Three asks are carried inside it (first drawn object, number of gates, world colour rows).
before: beats-v2.json: eight beats with actions and state flips that nothing binds to or measures; beat 4 posed as six body keys with no heap, no frame carried in, no nudge
after: screenplay.json is the target: every key, blocking action and emitter names its story point; probe-story checks each story point changes the world, not only the figure; the bible's script lane shows the active story point
